#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);

    long long n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

    long long x1 = min(n, m);
    long long x2 = max(n, m);

    if (x1 == 1) {
        int memo[] = {0, 1, 2, 3, 2, 1};
        cout << x1 * x2 - memo[x2 % 6] << "\n";
    } else if (x1 == 2) {
        if (x2 == 2) {
            cout << 0 << "\n";
        } else if (x2 == 3 || x2 == 7) {
            cout << x1 * x2 - 2 << "\n";
        } else {
            cout << x1 * x2 << "\n";
        }
    } else if ((x1 * x2) % 2 == 0) {
        cout << x1 * x2 << "\n";
    } else {
        cout << x1 * x2 - 1 << "\n";
    }

    return 0;
}
